mapper.sql: p.ppap_id, p.eco_id, p.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, p.submit_level, p.status, p.submitted_on, p.decided_on, p.decision_ref, p.decision_note, p.remark, p.row_ver, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
mapper.select: select from plm_ppap p join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id where p.eco_id = #{ecoId}
select from plm_ppap p join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id where p.ppap_id = #{ppapId}
select p.ppap_id, p.eco_id, p.cust_id, p.submit_level, p.status, p.submitted_on, p.decided_on, p.row_ver from plm_ppap p where p.ppap_id = #{ppapId} for update

select e.elem_id, e.elem_no, e.req_cd, e.status, e.file_id, f.orig_name as file_name, e.note, e.row_ver, e.apqp_kind, e.apqp_rev_id, e.apqp_label from plm_ppap_elem e left join sys_file f on f.file_id = e.file_id where e.ppap_id = #{ppapId} order by e.elem_no
insert into plm_ppap (comp_cd, eco_id, cust_id, submit_level, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{custId}, #{level}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning ppap_id
mapper.insert: insert into plm_ppap_elem (comp_cd, ppap_id, elem_no, req_cd, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ppapId}, #{elemNo}, #{reqCd}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.update: update plm_ppap set submit_level = #{level}, remark = #{remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ppap_id = #{ppapId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm from mst_item i where i.item_id in (select t.item_id from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id = #{ecoId}) order by i.item_cd
mapper.update: update plm_ppap set status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_on = #{on}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ppap_id = #{ppapId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select n.pcn_id, n.pcn_no, n.eco_id, n.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, n.notified_on, n.response_due, n.status, n.responded_on, n.response_note, n.note, (n.status = 'SENT' and n.response_due < #{today}) as overdue, n.row_ver from plm_pcn n join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id where n.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by n.pcn_id
select n.pcn_id, n.pcn_no, n.eco_id, n.cust_id, n.notified_on, n.response_due, n.status, n.row_ver from plm_pcn n where n.pcn_id = #{pcnId} for update

insert into plm_pcn (comp_cd, pcn_no, eco_id, cust_id, notified_on, response_due, note, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{ecoId}, #{custId}, #{notifiedOn}, #{due}, #{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{by}, #{by}) returning pcn_id

select t.contact_id, t.contact_nm, t.dept_nm, t.email, (t.main_yn = 'Y') as main from plm_pcn n join mst_cust_contact t on t.cust_id = n.cust_id where n.pcn_id = #{pcnId} and t.use_yn = 'Y' and t.email is not null and btrim(t.email) <> '' order by (t.main_yn = 'Y') desc, t.contact_nm, t.contact_id

select n.pcn_id, n.pcn_no, n.status, n.response_due, n.note, e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title as eco_title, e.reason_cd, e.effective_date, e.status as eco_status, c.comp_nm, c.locale_cd from plm_pcn n join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = n.eco_id join sys_comp c on c.comp_cd = n.comp_cd where n.pcn_id = #{pcnId}

insert into plm_pcn_mail (comp_cd, pcn_id, contact_id, to_addr, to_nm, subject, outbox_id, notice_file_id, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{pcnId}, #{contactId}, #{addr}, #{nm}, #{subject}, #{outboxId}, #{noticeFileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{by}) returning mail_id

select m.mail_id, m.pcn_id, m.to_nm, m.to_addr, m.created_at as sent_at, m.created_by as sent_by, m.outbox_id::text as outbox_id, m.notice_file_id, f.orig_name as notice_file_nm from plm_pcn_mail m join plm_pcn n on n.pcn_id = m.pcn_id left join sys_file f on f.file_id = m.notice_file_id where n.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by m.mail_id

select t.contact_id, t.contact_nm, t.dept_nm, t.email, (t.main_yn = 'Y') as main from plm_ppap p join mst_cust_contact t on t.cust_id = p.cust_id where p.ppap_id = #{ppapId} and t.use_yn = 'Y' and t.email is not null and btrim(t.email) <> '' order by (t.main_yn = 'Y') desc, t.contact_nm, t.contact_id

select p.ppap_id, p.status, p.submit_level, p.submitted_on, e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title as eco_title, e.status as eco_status, c.comp_nm, c.locale_cd from plm_ppap p join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = p.eco_id join sys_comp c on c.comp_cd = p.comp_cd where p.ppap_id = #{ppapId}

insert into plm_ppap_mail (comp_cd, ppap_id, contact_id, to_addr, to_nm, subject, outbox_id, summary_file_id, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ppapId}, #{contactId}, #{addr}, #{nm}, #{subject}, #{outboxId}, #{summaryFileId}, #{by}) returning mail_id

select m.mail_id, m.ppap_id, m.to_nm, m.to_addr, m.created_at as sent_at, m.created_by as sent_by, m.outbox_id::text as outbox_id, m.summary_file_id, f.orig_name as summary_file_nm from plm_ppap_mail m left join sys_file f on f.file_id = m.summary_file_id where m.ppap_id = #{ppapId} order by m.mail_id
